description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter-based attendance system application. It sets up the app widget tree, routes, state management, and initial UI components such as splash and home screens.

classes.name: AttendanceApp
classes.description: Root widget which initializes the Provider for AppState and sets up application routes and theme.

classes.name: _SplashScreen
classes.description: Displays a loading indicator during app initialization.

classes.name: _HomeShell
classes.description: Main navigation shell with bottom navigation bar and drawer for the logged-in home view.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The application's entry point which runs the AttendanceApp widget.

methods.name: AttendanceApp.build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, sets up provider for AppState, and configures routes based on login state.

methods.name: _SplashScreen.build
methods.description: Builds a splash screen with a CircularProgressIndicator.

methods.name: _HomeShell.createState
methods.description: Creates the state object for the _HomeShell widget.

methods.name: _HomeShell.build
methods.description: Builds the main home scaffold with navigation, pages, and drawer.
